biotools.summary: MetaboAnalystR is an R-based workflow designed to streamline LC-MS metabolomics data analysis, covering raw spectra processing, compound identification, statistical analysis, and functional interpretation. It provides a unified, end-to-end pipeline for metabolomic research.
